description:
Extract SparkSession management from pyspark_df.py into a shared module
that can be used by both DataFrame and SQL adapters.

This enables the dual-mode PySpark platform architecture where both SQL
and DataFrame modes share a single SparkSession (required by JVM constraint
of one SparkSession per process).

Key responsibilities of SparkSessionManager:
- Singleton pattern respecting one SparkSession per JVM
- Shared configuration: master, memory, executor settings, AQE
- Java version detection with clear error messages (17/21 required, 23+ rejected)
- Graceful shutdown handling
